input: TJU B. subtilis frozen v2, same Discovery/Development as MEME/STREME
streme: existing Discovery natural-background full streme.txt, one run
embedding: existing Discovery L6W10 candidate pools per method and seed, natural background data
ranking: Discovery positive minus natural control leakage-group presence; zero-order complementary-symmetric natural background; per PWM natural-control 90th percentile, strict >, both strands; tie by information, ID
evaluation: identical PWM scoring and fixed Discovery threshold on same Development positive, natural control and paired shuffled controls; group-level OR over each candidate set
similarity: CNN Discovery-ranked top5 vs STREME all10; centered cosine over best offset and strand; overlap at least max(5,ceil(0.6*shorter width)); no cosine threshold; report overlap
position: per CNN top3 Discovery-selected instance, PWM center relative to TSS=local index60, raw sequence-level counts, not Development reference positions
limitations: retrospective data already observed; CNN training uses sequence labels and its candidate extraction differs; STREME one run not two seeds; MEME full PWM unavailable; no new Holdout access
